messages:
ajay: Hey folks — PR 7016 is ready but staging canary shows a tail latency regression on long-seq workloads (2k tokens). Need 2 approvals to merge. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7016

ci-bot: canary-deploy: PR 7016 deployed to staging-canary at 1964321200. Perf run started.

maria: looked at the canary logs — p99 up ~18% for seq=2048 compared to main. p50/p95 flat. gist: https://gist.github.com/maria/7016-longseq-bench

kevin: what did this PR change exactly?

ajay: small changes to microbatch allocator heuristics + kv cache eviction ordering. main diff:
```
- batch_window_ms default 8 -> 12
- eviction: prefer oldest-prefetch-first -> LRU-ish last_used
```

sam: odd — increasing batch window can reduce CPU but might increase tail when sequence lengths vary. I'll run a focused long-seq bench locally.

sam: local bench (runcmd: ./bench --model llama-2-13b --seq 2048 --concurrency 8)
- main: p50 72ms / p95 120ms / p99 190ms / mem 8.6GB
- pr7016: p50 74ms / p95 125ms / p99 227ms / mem 9.4GB

maria: flamegraph shows spike in attention kernel at tail requests, CPU context switching up. https://perf.redwood/maria/7016-flame

kevin: thanks. That memory bump + attention spike suggests the eviction ordering increases cache churn for long context — more KV reloads per request -> tail.

ajay: ah yes, eviction ordering was intended to improve average throughput but I didn't fully account for skewed long-seq traces.

kevin: options: 1) revert the eviction ordering change (safe, quick), 2) make batch_window opt-in behind a feature flag and keep eviction change but tune policy, 3) add an adaptive check: if seq>1024 keep legacy eviction.

maria: I prefer revert for now so we don't risk customer regressions. We can follow up with adaptive policy in a new PR.

ajay: I can open revert PR now (will be small). Asking @kevin and @maria for approvals to merge the revert into main so we can stabilize.

kevin: ack — will review revert PR. If it's tiny I'll approve.

sam: also +1 for revert, but can you post quick bench after revert to confirm tails back to baseline?

ajay: will run canary after revert and post numbers. Targeting revert PR in next 30m.

ci-bot: pr-created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7020 by ajay (revert: eviction-ordering)

maria: reviewing now. If looks good will approve and request canary run.

ajay: plan: hold PR 7016 merge until revert 7020 lands and canary benches show p99 within 5% of main. After that I'll rework eviction policy behind feature flag and submit new PR with targeted tests.

kevin: sounds good. tagging @oncall-runtime in case this needs incident escalation but shouldn't.

ajay: thanks all. will update thread with canary numbers. :thumbsup:
